name: Visual Anomaly (VisA) Dataset
description: Industrial visual anomaly detection dataset containing 10,821 high-resolution color images across 12 objects in 3 domains, with image-level and pixel-level labels for normal and anomalous samples.
citation: Zou, Y., Jeong, J., Pemula, L., Zhang, D., & Dabeer, O. (2022). SPot-the-Difference Self-Supervised Pre-training for Anomaly Detection and Segmentation. European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV). arXiv:2207.14315. https://arxiv.org/abs/2207.14315

license.notes: A standard SPDX license for the dataset was not identified. Review the upstream dataset terms and underlying image rights before use or redistribution.
